entry.title: open = close: adding ±1σ error bars to snow forecasts
entry.summary: As everyone knows in AI land, open = close—so close = open. After enough ski friends nudged me, I built CloseSnow, a 100% free, zero-paywall mountain snowfall forecaster across 120 Ikon and Epic resorts. Compared to a certain familiar paid snow app, it puts calibrated ±1σ error bars directly on every daily bar so you can see the real uncertainty spread instead of getting burned by an overconfident single number. On my held-out 221-storm SNOTEL backtest, it reached 2.37" 48h storm MAE (vs. OpenSnow’s 4.01").

entry.title: Why I don’t put primary logins or payment cards into a cloud bot vault
entry.summary: Two practical details worth checking before putting primary logins or cards into a cloud bot vault: vault entries and browser state on the bot VM are shared account-wide across your bots rather than isolated per workflow, and saved payment cards can auto-fill at checkout without a separate per-purchase approval prompt. Importing existing logins also goes through a plaintext CSV export on disk.

entry.title: Why I built Foliofen CLI while the portal kept changing
entry.summary: Patient-owned records should be exportable without handing a third party a permanent view of the account. This build uses a local Chrome and Puppeteer harness, keeps credentials in the user’s browser, and treats every export as a visible, reviewable step.

entry.title: Why I built a local MyChart exporter while caring for a NICU baby
entry.summary: While our family was caring for a medically complex NICU baby, notes and lab results changed every day. The hard part wasn’t reading a single result—it was making sure the next question we asked used the latest chart without uploading sensitive records to a third-party cloud service.

entry.title: Show HN: Foliofen CLI — What a technical audience stress-tested first
entry.summary: Putting a privacy-first export tool in front of a technical audience sharpened the message: local control is a product feature, but only when the recovery path and the limits are clear too.

entry.title: Building a free, open-source tracker for credit-card benefits
